precedence: Industry standards bind both sides. On a Northfield order, Northfield’s rule governs; a signed vendor agreement overrides the guide where it speaks. Ashby’s policy applies where Northfield is silent, and may be stricter than Northfield but never looser. An Ashby agreement with Kinross or the marketplace binds Ashby, but is no defence against a Northfield charge (NF-10.1). Most Ashby rules exist to meet a Northfield rule; the Implements column names it.

rules.statement: The current PO revision is the commitment; a change counts only on an order change

Change requests go to the buyer, who issues the order change; answer an order change within 24 hours of the latest change
The order acknowledgment carries the transaction totals segment (CTT) with the number of lines; the X12 standard leaves it optional
No backorders: a short line is cancelled and the shipped quantity reported

rules.statement: Ship-to matches the current PO
Line numbers match the current PO
Units per case match Northfield’s item setup
Every item is on Northfield’s item list for the supplier; a substitute needs the buyer’s approval first
The ship-to GLN is an active Northfield location
The carton count in the ship notice equals the cartons listed under it
Quantities are in cases (CA)
The ship date is on or before the delivery date
Full truckloads are shipper load and count, sealed at origin
Northfield records the seal number and its condition at arrival
On a sealed trailer the receiving count stands unless the supplier proves the carton was loaded with a load scan or a load tally by SSCC; the delivery receipt proves the seal, not the count
A receipt changes only through a revised receiving advice; a deduction reversal alone does not change it
Deductions are taken on the remittance with a reason code and deduction reference; detail sits in the deduction case
Northfield sends no debit memos; supplier corrections travel as a credit memo or corrected invoice
Dispute once per deduction, within 60 days of the remittance date, in the deduction case

The invoice bills the shipped quantity at the accepted PO price; an invoice that bills more is held

rules.statement: The invoice total equals the sum of its line amounts
Invoice line prices within 0.5% of the acknowledged order price are paid without review; beyond that the line is held
On time. Prepaid: DC arrival inside the must-arrive-by window. Collect: freight ready by the assigned pickup
In full: cases received against cases ordered per PO line, on the PO revision current at shipment; a cancelled remainder counts as not received
Counting unit: cases. Score is compliant cases over all cases in the period
Targets: prepaid on time 90%, collect ready 98%, in full 95%

rules.statement: Exclusions: Northfield’s routed carrier late on collect freight; DC refusal or closure; a PO changed after the routing request
Measured monthly on a rolling 13-week scorecard; OT01 and OT02 are billed quarterly
Scorecard published monthly as a file, with definition version, period and counting unit
Below a target two months running: agree a corrective action plan within 30 days

The supplier’s plan states the cause, actions with owners and timing, baseline, definition, comparison population, minimum observations and required evidence. Northfield accepts it and keeps it with the scorecard
Minimum observations: 30 baseline failing PO lines and an equal comparison period on the same DC set
Northfield charges the supplier for shortage and compliance, whoever handled the freight
The claimant shows good condition at origin, loss or damage at delivery, and the amount
Shortage: invoice cost of each short carton plus $50
Acknowledge the quantity Ashby can ship, not the quantity ordered
